source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
This Shadow Legion rule needs **LEGIONES DAEMONICA** as your Army Faction. Each ability below applies only to your units with the keywords it names:

- **Murderer’s Cowl**: Advancing doesn't stop a **SHADOW LEGION KHORNE** unit from shooting or declaring a charge that turn.
- **Penumbral Puppetry**: a **SHADOW LEGION TZEENTCH** unit has **[Stealth](vsdata:core-ability/stealth)**, and melee attacks that target it get -1 to Hit.
- **Gloam Rot**: when an attack's Strength is greater than the Toughness of the **SHADOW LEGION NURGLE** unit it targets, the attack gets -1 to Wound.
- **Shadow’s Caress**: enemy units can't pick a **SHADOW LEGION SLAANESH** unit as a target of [snap shooting](vsdata:core-rule/snap-shooting) attacks.

**Disciples of Be’lakor**, for **SHADOW LEGION UNDIVIDED** units:

- The unit gains Dark Pacts as an army rule, used as Codex: Chaos Space Marines describes, though your Army Faction isn't **HERETIC ASTARTES**. A **BE’LAKOR** unit passes the Dark Pacts Leadership test automatically.
- Its **SHADOW LEGION HERETIC ASTARTES** models have **[Deep Strike](vsdata:core-ability/deep-strike)**.
